text:
alex: Quick sync — final copy for the packaging matrix FAQ + calculator. Two items before I push to prod: 1) naming for the three tiers (we want friendly but not fuzzy). 2) how explicit should the calculator assumptions be?

maria: For names, prefer descriptors that hint at scale/use case. My roughs: Launch, Growth, Dedicated. avoids 'starter' vibe but still clear.

jonathan: +1 to giving a short one-line under each name. e.g., 'Launch — prototype & low-volume pilots' etc. Helps people self-select.

alex: Good. Another thought: emphasize 'Committed throughput' vs 'Burst capacity' language in FAQ. A few folks misread 'reserved' in the last test.

devon: Can we call it 'Committed throughput (monthly)' and 'Burst capacity (on-demand)'? That was the most straightforward in customer interviews.

maria: I like that. For the calculator, we should surface the main levers: avg tokens / prompt, requests per month, concurrency. Show default examples (chat vs embeddings).

jonathan: Example snippet we can show in the FAQ (one-line): "Estimated monthly cost = (avg tokens per request * requests per month / 1000) * $per_1k_tokens + embedding_units * $per_embedding"

alex: Paste that in code block on the page? We should also include a link to a longer explainer modal.

maria: Yes — short formula visible, expanded explainer modal for advanced assumptions (KV cache hit rates, batching, quantization).

alex: UX question — A/B test variant A: calculator with single-step defaults + prefilled example 'chat bot 50k msgs/mo'. Variant B: advanced slider UI for tokens/concurrency. Which do we prioritize for the launch?

devon: Start with A (low friction), run 2-week test. If conversion drop, roll B as second exposure.

jonathan: Also capture initial analytics: drop-off at slider, clicks to 'explain assumptions', and time-on-calculator. Tag events: pricing_calc_open, pricing_calc_submit, pricing_modal_view.

alex: Noted. @sam-bot can you add a quick checklist to the release PR?

sam-bot: added checklist comment to PR #4821 — items: update FAQ copy, add formula snippet, embed modal link, add GA events, set A/B flag 'pricing_calc_v1'.

maria: One more copy nit — for the FAQ Q: 'What is committed throughput?' proposed answer: 'Committed throughput is a monthly reserved capacity you pay to guarantee latency and capacity for production traffic. It reduces per-token unit costs compared to on-demand usage.' Keep it <=2 sentences.

alex: Perfect. I'll update the copy doc and ping design for the compact formula block. Can we get a 24h turnaround?

devon: I'll queue design tomorrow morning.

jonathan: I'll add the analytics spec after lunch and wire the feature flag.

alex: Thanks everyone. We'll ship the A variant and check metrics after 2 weeks.

maria: :rocket:
